title: Knik Glacier Off-Road and Kayaking Adventure from Anchorage
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the wild beauty of Alaska on an unforgettable guided adventure to Knik Glacier. This tour combines thrilling off-road exploration through the scenic Knik River valley with an exhilarating kayaking experience on glacier-fed waters. Marvel at stunning mountain views and encounter wildlife while capturing incredible photos of the spectacular landscapes. Kayak among floating icebergs, all while receiving expert guidance to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts looking for a small-group adventure near Anchorage, this tour offers a unique way to connect with Alaska's pristine wilderness.

- Guided off-road journey through the stunning Knik River valley
- Kayak in serene glacier-fed waters near Knik Glacier
- Capture breathtaking views of floating ice and the wilderness
- Enjoy a small-group experience with knowledgeable local guides
